arxiv-2105-07613.title: Nonparametric regression for locally stationary functional time series
arxiv-2105-07613.creator: Daisuke Kurisu
arxiv-2105-07613.description: Abstract . In this study, we develop an asymptotic theory of nonparametric regression for a locally stationary functional time series. Then, we propose a nonparametric model for LSFTS with a regression function that changes smoothly over time.

arxiv-2207-13510.description: Abstract The LUXE experiment (Laser Und XFEL Experiment) is an experiment in planning at DESY Hamburg using the electron beam of the European XFEL (Eu.XFEL). arxiv-2207-14384.description: Abstract UV wind line variability in OB stars appears to be universal. We review the evidence that the variability is due to large, dense, optically thick structures rooted in or near the photosphere. Using repeated observations and a simple model we translate observed profile variations into optical depth variations and, consequently, variations in measured mass loss rates.

arxiv-2409-16401.title: The Influence of Quantum Correlation on the Holonomy of Spatially-Structured Bi-Photons
arxiv-2409-16401.creator: Mark T. Lusk
arxiv-2409-16401.description: Abstract The manifestation of entanglement within geometric phase is elucidated for spatially-structured bi-photons. This screening revealed 42 host factors critical for ALV-J infection.

uslaw-usc-t22-s10809.title: 22 U.S.C. § 10809 — Prohibition on purchase of sovereign debt of the Russian Federation by United States persons
uslaw-usc-t22-s10809.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t22-s10809.description: United States Code, Title 22 (Foreign Relations And Intercourse); Chapter 115 (Sanctions With Respect To The Russian Federation). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Upon the enactment of this Act, the purchase of sovereign debt of the Government of the Russian Federation by any United States person (including a United States financial institution) is prohibited.
